61: 1. Bootlicking leads a person to foul language, and vice-versa.
2. Bootlicking can make a man's wife be widowed and his children orphaned, without anyone having compassion on them.
4. Someone who walks in the marketplace and falls, he's definitely got bootlicking in him.
6. Whoever's surety and confidence is dependent on others, will succumb to bootlicking.
7. Keeping oneself from bootlocking will bring his salvation.
8. It is permitted to kiss up to wicked people in this world [Sotah 41; presumably to cast them down].
10. It also prevents his prayer from being heard, and makes him repulsive in everyones' eyes.
